changelog.body:
PPS now uses `io.github.asadman1523.pps`. Android installs it separately from the previous package. Disable the old module in LSPosed, enable PPS for Pixel Launcher only, and restart your phone. Existing shortcuts keep their original identifiers.

設定頁已移除原先的品牌標頭。若曾使用舊模組，請先在 LSPosed 停用舊版，再啟用新版 PPS，僅勾選 Pixel Launcher，然後重新啟動手機。

The attached universal APK is signed by Google Play. Its SHA-256 checksum is included below.

PPS (Private Space Shortcuts) lets you open the private copy of an app from your Home screen. Unlock Private Space, press and hold the app, then choose “Add to Home screen.” Its icon remains visible on your Home screen when Private Space is locked. Tapping it opens Android’s authentication prompt. Canceling leaves the app closed.

You need a rooted phone with Android Private Space, a working LSPosed installation, and a compatible version of Pixel Launcher. Enable PPS in LSPosed, select only Pixel Launcher, and restart your phone. The launcher integration has been tested on Android 17. Compatibility can change with launcher updates.

PPS is an independent open-source project. Google and the LSPosed project do not develop, sponsor, or endorse PPS.

## Installing or migrating

[Download PPS](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.asadman1523.pps/releases/latest) · `io.github.asadman1523.pps`

Disable the old module in LSPosed before enabling PPS. The new package installs as a separate app.

`io.github.asadman1523.privatespaceshortcuts` → `io.github.asadman1523.pps`

[Source](https://github.com/asadman1523/pixel-private-space-shortcuts) · [Previous releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.asadman1523.privatespaceshortcuts/releases)
